name: signalscope
description: Browser-class signal analyzer with native C++ DSP backend

scripts.build:ui: mkdir -p dist/renderer && cp src/renderer/index.html dist/renderer/ && esbuild src/renderer/index.jsx --bundle --outfile=dist/renderer/bundle.js --loader:.jsx=jsx --jsx=automatic --define:process.env.NODE_ENV=\"production\"
scripts.dev:ui: mkdir -p dist/renderer && cp src/renderer/index.html dist/renderer/ && esbuild src/renderer/index.jsx --bundle --outfile=dist/renderer/bundle.js --loader:.jsx=jsx --jsx=automatic --define:process.env.NODE_ENV=\"development\"
scripts.build:backend: cmake -B build/backend -S src/backend && cmake --build build/backend --config Release
scripts.build:backend:static: cmake -B build/backend -S src/backend -DSTATIC_FFTW=ON && cmake --build build/backend --config Release
scripts.build:backend:simple-ws: cmake -B build/backend-simple -S src/backend -DFORCE_SIMPLE_WS=ON && cmake --build build/backend-simple --config Release
scripts.test:backend: npm run build:backend:simple-ws && cmake -B build/tests -S tests/backend && cmake --build build/tests && ctest --test-dir build/tests --output-on-failure
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:renderer
scripts.predist: npm run build:backend && npm run build:ui
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build:backend        && npm run build:ui && electron-builder --linux AppImage
scripts.dist:linux:static: npm run build:backend:static && npm run build:ui && electron-builder --linux AppImage   '--config.appImage.artifactName=SignalScope-${version}-static.${ext}'
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:backend        && npm run build:ui && electron-builder --win portable
scripts.dist:win:static: npm run build:backend:static && npm run build:ui && electron-builder --win portable     '--config.portable.artifactName=SignalScope-${version}-portable-static.${ext}'
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build:backend        && npm run build:ui && electron-builder --mac dmg
scripts.dist:mac:static: npm run build:backend:static && npm run build:ui && electron-builder --mac dmg          '--config.dmg.artifactName=SignalScope-${version}-static.${ext}'
scripts.pack:linux: npm run dist:linux        && cmake -B build/pack-shared -S packaging -DSIGNALSCOPE_VARIANT=shared && cmake --build build/pack-shared --target package
scripts.pack:linux:static: npm run dist:linux:static && cmake -B build/pack-static -S packaging -DSIGNALSCOPE_VARIANT=static && cmake --build build/pack-static --target package
scripts.pack:win: npm run dist:win          && cmake -B build/pack-shared -S packaging -DSIGNALSCOPE_VARIANT=shared && cmake --build build/pack-shared --target package
scripts.pack:win:static: npm run dist:win:static   && cmake -B build/pack-static -S packaging -DSIGNALSCOPE_VARIANT=static && cmake --build build/pack-static --target package
scripts.pack:mac: npm run dist:mac          && cmake -B build/pack-shared -S packaging -DSIGNALSCOPE_VARIANT=shared && cmake --build build/pack-shared --target package
scripts.pack:mac:static: npm run dist:mac:static   && cmake -B build/pack-static -S packaging -DSIGNALSCOPE_VARIANT=static && cmake --build build/pack-static --target package
